applies_to: ABB ACH550 HVAC drives on embedded fieldbus (Modbus RTU) with parameter 5305 = 1 (DCU profile), read by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for the ABB ACH550 when its embedded fieldbus uses the DCU control profile: 609 objects (546 AI, 4 AO, 59 BI), 138 polled by default. Coil and status bits (STOP, START, RUNNING, FAULT, ALARM), the 16- and 32-bit control/status words, the actual signals and the whole parameter list are mapped. Four Analog Outputs write the control words and the two references.
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile ABB_Drive_DCU_5305_is_1_a_LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the ACH550 user's manual (3AUA0000081823), embedded fieldbus section (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/3AUA0000081823_REVC.pdf).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.
Only 138 of the 609 rows are flagged for polling in the profile; the rest are served only after you tick them in the gateway. Their descriptions say "not polled by default".

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.
Some names appear more than once in the profile as published (INTEGRATION TIME; DERIVATION TIME; GAIN...); they are kept as printed and told apart by instance.

integration.summary: Set the drive for fieldbus control (EXT1 commands and reference = COMM) and 5305 = 1. With the DCU profile the drive takes start/stop from the ACH550 control word (AO 74, register 40031); write the speed reference to Reference 1 (AO 63). Read RUNNING, FAULT, ALARM and the actual values.

minimum_points.name: ACH550 CONTROL WORD LSW
minimum_points.why: DCU control word, low word: start/stop, reset bits

integration.enable: Set EXT1 commands (parameter 1001) to 10 (COMM) and the speed reference source to COMM as the ACH550 manual describes, and parameter 5305 = 1. In this mode start/stop comes from register 40031 (AO 74), not 40001.
setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
gotchas: ACH550 parameter 5305 (EFB CTRL PROFILE) selects the control profile: 0 = ABB DRV LIM, 1 = DCU PROFILE, 2 = ABB DRV FULL. Load the BASgatewayLX profile that matches it.
AO 62 (register 40001) is the ABB DRV control word; with 5305 = 1 the drive uses the ACH550 control word at 40031 (AO 74) instead.
Unpolled rows do not appear as BACnet objects until enabled in the gateway's device profile page.
